sections.title: اختتامیہ — متن (231)

paras.text: The inside back cover prints the National Anthem of Pakistan (written by Hafeez Jalandhari). Summary: it blesses the sacred land of Pakistan as the symbol of a high resolve and the centre of faith; it prays that the order of the land, built on the strength of the brotherhood of the people, keep the nation, country and state forever flourishing; and it describes the crescent-and-star flag as the guide to progress and perfection, the interpreter of the past and the glory of the present, under the shade of God the Majestic.
